title: KOEI 12 Simulated Human Player Profiles — Differentiated Competence and Personality v1.1
status: DESIGN COMPLETE / STATIC QA PASS ONLY; implementation and live campaign tests NOT RUN
scope: New native Windows Koei-inspired strategy game only; not the separate ROTK II port, ROM wrapper, or NES mod
source_basis: Adapted from the user-approved Koei_Windows_Game_Master_Project_Plan.md and Advisor_System_Module_Spec.md. Original-game player research is an intended later calibration source, not claimed complete.

policy_contract.decision_style: At each eligible decision phase: inspect only information allowed by the persona; apply mandatory command legality; score eligible actions by weighted priorities adjusted for profile rules, needs, and risks; prefer the highest score; use a seedable tie-breaker.
policy_contract.priority_scale: Integer weights sum to 100. They are starting test preferences, not hard-coded game formulas or a fully defined decision algorithm.
policy_contract.attention_budget: attention_actions_per_month limits voluntary tactical/administrative decisions; basic interface and automatic monthly processing do not spend budget. BP costs remain enforced separately.
policy_contract.mistakes: Represent limited foresight and imperfect inspection, not hidden-information cheats or direct corruption of state. Mistakes chosen deterministically from fixed input/seed and profile.
policy_contract.legality: Submit only commands available to an ordinary player at the same snapshot. No private economy, hidden enemy data, direct state writes, free supplies, or exempted BP.
policy_contract.advisor_boundary: Advisor and spring/fall reports are read-only; monthly advice is menu-accessible, not a popup.
policy_contract.unimplemented_features: If a subsystem does not exist, skip it with recorded unavailable reason; do not pretend the profile exercised it.

test_protocol.campaigns: Run each persona on the same scenario, faction, starting snapshot, seed, and rules version; include multiple starting regions, resource conditions, and difficulty settings as each feature becomes available.
test_protocol.paired_runs: Compare same seed and setup across profiles. Repeat across independent fixed seeds to distinguish policy effects from random outcomes.
test_protocol.save_replay: For every profile, preserve a verbatim action/event journal and verify that replay from the same save/RNG reproduces the same state checksum.
capture: advisor accuracy and seasonal report deduplication
player-persona goal completion and reasons for failure
test_protocol.evaluate: Report game-breaking invariant failures separately from legitimate strategic losses, tedious UX, dominant-strategy imbalance, and unmet persona goals.
test_protocol.required_skill_counterfactuals: For each Pxx, create a temporary controlled clone of SAME personality/goal/weights/attention with competence lowered one or more tiers; compare legal visible-context decision quality on matched seeds, not just win rates. Do not publish clones as extra canonical players.
differentiation_assertions: Each Pxx has a distinct signature plan, specialist mastery and weakness
No trained player is guaranteed best output outside specialty
Novice and expert obey identical game rules, resource and visibility constraints
More skill changes action evaluation not bonus resources
P11 can be effective with two decisions per month and P12 is an adversarial specialist

profiles.name: The Curious Beginner
profiles.persona: First-time player who learns by browsing and experimenting rather than optimizing.
profiles.goal: Make visible progress, try appealing commands, keep the campaign alive.
behaviors: Favor recently discovered actions and visibly large immediate gains over incremental returns.
Try each newly unlocked menu at least once if a legal and affordable action is available.
Respond to red warnings after they appear; do not proactively audit every ledger.
Revisit a prior successful action even when local capacity has changed.
blind_spots: Neglects long-range food forecasts and the distinction between stocks and deferred harvest.
May pay for superficially attractive projects with poor labor or material returns.
profiles.challenge: Can a novice find the necessary information and recover from ordinary mistakes without external guidance?
failure_signatures: Unexpected famine after apparent prosperity
Repeated invalid commands, menu loops, or unexplained BP depletion

competence.signature_plan: Explore an unfamiliar menu; reward immediate, visible payoff
behavioral_rules: After first positive result, repeat a legal action once without comparing long-run alternatives
When food warning becomes explicit, switch to first affordable relief before checking underlying production
Inspect unknown menu on alternating months when no urgent warning exists
competence.adaptation_trigger: After two visibly unproductive repeats, stop trying that action for three months

personality.preferred_goal: Make visible progress, try appealing commands, keep the campaign alive.

profiles.name: The Careful Survivor
profiles.persona: Risk-averse player prioritizing resilience, reserves, and low regret.
profiles.goal: Survive bad harvests and external threats without catastrophic losses.
behaviors: Keep a conservative food and gold buffer using available engine forecasts.
Raise flood protection or repair infrastructure when exposed even if weapons would yield faster conquest.
Avoid war without supplies, equipment, and a credible escape or defensive plan.
Only buy or build after verifying that upkeep does not endanger the next two seasons.
blind_spots: Overinvests in insurance and may permanently miss favorable expansion windows.
Holds idle treasury and labor longer than necessary.
profiles.challenge: Does patient defensive play remain viable and rewarding rather than a permanently losing trap?
failure_signatures: Safe but stagnant campaign
Economic death spiral despite apparently prudent forecasts

competence.signature_plan: Maintain two-season food buffer and a defensible frontier
competence.strategic_blindspot: Forfeits timing windows through excess caution
behavioral_rules: Reject legal offensive actions if visible reserves below a two-season cushion unless homeland is at immediate risk
Use the warning and reserve screens before high-cost orders
Reserve treasury for harvest failure and upkeep before optional projects
competence.adaptation_trigger: If six months without improvement and no threat, release bounded reserve to the highest-risk-adjusted upgrade

personality.preferred_goal: Survive bad harvests and external threats without catastrophic losses.
personality.bias_description: Forfeits timing windows through excess caution

profiles.name: The Impatient Conqueror
profiles.persona: Aggressive military player who seeks territory before a stable economic base.
profiles.goal: Capture neighboring territory rapidly and keep the offensive moving.
behaviors: Spend early surplus on recruitment, equipment, training, and near-term army supply.
Attack when local strength appears favorable instead of waiting for optimal industry.
Move troops and material aggressively between frontier provinces.
Treat morale/support and civilian labor as secondary unless unrest or shortages block orders.
blind_spots: Underestimates seasonal harvest timing, attrition, opportunity cost of conscription.
May overextend supply chains or conquer unprofitable provinces.
profiles.challenge: Are early wars possible without resource creation, but costly enough to discourage effortless snowballing?
failure_signatures: Army supply collapse or mass demobilization
Runaway conquest with no meaningful economic tradeoff

competence.signature_plan: Attack strongest favorable frontier position before competitor consolidates
competence.strategic_blindspot: Supply, social support and occupation economics
behavioral_rules: Use troop/equipment matchups and known terrain to pick among current targets
Accept near-term shortage if legal victory estimate crosses chosen threshold
Retain reserve troops for one counterattack but treat civil projects as secondary
competence.adaptation_trigger: If two campaigns fail or force collapses, pause attacks and rebuild supplies for up to three months

personality.preferred_goal: Capture neighboring territory rapidly and keep the offensive moving.
personality.bias_description: Supply, social support and occupation economics

profiles.name: The Agrarian Planner
profiles.persona: Development-focused administrator who sees cultivation and labor productivity as the path to power.
profiles.goal: Grow a sustainable food surplus and productive civilian population over several years.
behaviors: Assign enough farmers to meet long-run food goals before growing nonfarm sectors.
Invest in cultivation, flood protection, and land crews when marginal returns warrant it.
Plan around the specified annual harvest and tax dates, not instant monthly credits.
Expand industry only after verifying surplus labor and food.
blind_spots: May underproduce equipment and lose to opportunistic neighbors.
Can mistake bigger harvest for better per-worker productivity.
profiles.challenge: Does persistent labor outperform repeated direct investment where it should, and are tradeoffs visible?
failure_signatures: Labor duplication or September staffing exploit
Investment dominates or is dominated regardless of local conditions

competence.signature_plan: Maximize multi-harvest per-worker yield, not gross harvest alone
behavioral_rules: Estimate marginal food per labor and action BP; compare sustained workforce versus one-off investment
Time staffing and projects around actual annual event calendar
Decline a high-output farm upgrade if reserve depletion creates unacceptable interharvest risk
competence.adaptation_trigger: If production misses forecast by two observations, recalibrate yields and reallocate workforce next available turn

personality.preferred_goal: Grow a sustainable food surplus and productive civilian population over several years.

profiles.name: The Benevolent Governor
profiles.persona: People-first player who protects popular support and accepts slower expansion.
profiles.goal: Maintain high public support while improving food security and resilience.
behaviors: Prefer relief, specialty-goods distribution, and fair policy over emergency requisition.
Treat loss of support as a real cost of resource collection and rapid recruitment.
Reject lucrative trade if it creates a credible local shortage or social crisis.
Prioritize recovery if support falls below a self-selected safe band.
blind_spots: Can sacrifice military security and investment income to maintain high approval.
May use goods distribution excessively if its support gain is overstated.
profiles.challenge: Are support-oriented decisions meaningful without turning gift distribution into infinite popularity?
failure_signatures: Support farming or zero-cost gift exploit
Unrecoverable support-to-tax-to-famine spiral

competence.signature_plan: Hold public support above the chosen floor without repetitive zero-cost gifts
behavioral_rules: Compare relief/support gain to actual stock cost and visible unrest risk
Maintain food before distributing discretionary goods
Do not recruit into visible starvation merely to meet an army target
competence.adaptation_trigger: If support remains high for two reporting seasons, reduce discretionary distributions and fund essential defenses

personality.preferred_goal: Maintain high public support while improving food security and resilience.

profiles.name: The Market Operator
profiles.persona: Price-sensitive trader trying to finance state expansion through exchange.
profiles.goal: Maximize sustainable trading profits net of BP, transport, and displaced labor.
behaviors: Compare commodity prices, seasonal windows, local demand, and marginal 500-unit tiers.
Use an available high-Charisma negotiator when expected benefits exceed alternative officer work.
Split, combine, or stage trades to discover which legitimate pricing strategy is best.
Preserve sufficient local food and production inputs to avoid undermining next season.
blind_spots: May spend excessive officer time to chase small margins.
Treats illiquid inventory as wealth and underestimates convoy risk.
profiles.challenge: Are marginal tiers understandable and profitable without zero-price rounding or buy-sell arbitrage?
failure_signatures: Profit from pure buy-sell loops
Single commodity or single merchant strategy always wins

competence.signature_plan: Profit from legal seasonal spreads after BP, officer and stock opportunity costs
competence.strategic_blindspot: Counterparty risk and distant military implications
behavioral_rules: Preview 499/500/501 marginal quantity steps where current engine supports them
Estimate net cash impact and next-month stock scarcity before trading
Use Charisma negotiator only when incremental expected benefit exceeds competing officer role
competence.adaptation_trigger: After two weak-margin trades, switch commodity or wait for visible seasonal quote change

personality.preferred_goal: Maximize sustainable trading profits net of BP, transport, and displaced labor.
personality.bias_description: Counterparty risk and distant military implications

profiles.name: The Arsenal Builder
profiles.persona: Resource-and-industry specialist focused on metal, timber, arms, and equipment readiness.
profiles.goal: Maintain reliable domestic manufacture without exhausting strategic inputs.
behaviors: Map finite deposits and renewable timber/fur yield before scaling production.
Reserve metal and other inputs for priority arms contracts before luxury craft.
Balance miners, foresters, smiths/artisans, and agriculture using one civilian workforce.
Avoid building equipment no army can use without an explicit future plan.
blind_spots: May overbuild capacity before demand appears.
May keep too little gold for wages, trade, or development.
profiles.challenge: Do recipes, scarce materials, worker opportunity costs, and equipment allocation stay coherent?
failure_signatures: Same metal used in multiple production queues
Equipping more soldiers than arms actually exist

competence.signature_plan: Remove the binding input or labor bottleneck in weapon production
competence.strategic_blindspot: Sunk industrial capacity and treasury liquidity
behavioral_rules: Identify least available input at each planned recipe and reserve it once
Compare equipment utilization against current troop roster before committing a new run
Minimize idle industrial queues when a needed input can be acquired legally
competence.adaptation_trigger: After two completed runs with unissued equipment, slow production and free labor for food/cash

personality.preferred_goal: Maintain reliable domestic manufacture without exhausting strategic inputs.
personality.bias_description: Sunk industrial capacity and treasury liquidity

profiles.name: The Artisan Exporter
profiles.persona: Genghis-style specialist who builds prosperity through region-specific crafts.
profiles.goal: Create a diversified, profitable artisan economy whose goods have strategic uses.
behaviors: Choose regional recipes based on accessible inputs, labor productivity, and local trade value.
Compare selling craft goods with distributing them for support or reserving them for projects.
Adjust artisan mix seasonally without assuming completed items are available early.
Diversify when a market becomes saturated or transport limits exports.
blind_spots: Can chase luxury profitability while ignoring arms and defenses.
May neglect more profitable raw-material exports or farming.
profiles.challenge: Are ten specialty goods differentiated and worth producing rather than decorative inventory?
failure_signatures: Infinite value from input-free crafting
All artisan recipes reduce to the same optimal good

competence.signature_plan: Choose specialty goods by marginal labor-value, input availability and saturated demand
competence.strategic_blindspot: Defense and supplies for prolonged campaigns
behavioral_rules: Choose recipe based on current yield and net realizable price, not base nominal price
Test selling versus public-support distribution using actually visible cost
Diversify after visible market saturation rather than producing the single highest listed price item
competence.adaptation_trigger: If exports miss seasonal net-profit target twice, move workforce to next feasible regional recipe

personality.preferred_goal: Create a diversified, profitable artisan economy whose goods have strategic uses.
personality.bias_description: Defense and supplies for prolonged campaigns

profiles.name: The River-and-Sea Logistician
profiles.persona: Movement-focused ruler using ships, ports, and convoys to integrate provinces.
profiles.goal: Exploit geography with viable fleets and reliable interprovince supply routes.
behaviors: Favor water-linked provinces and build ships only when actual routes need them.
Reserve crews and materials before committing hulls or shipments.
Measure delivery lead time, capacity, escort risk, and convoy loss instead of comparing local stocks alone.
Move food, metal, and arms where regional specialization creates the greatest benefit.
blind_spots: Can overspend on hulls and route management.
Undervalues a simple overland solution when waterways are inconvenient.
profiles.challenge: Are ships useful where geography justifies them without duplicated cargo or free transport?
failure_signatures: Same hull or cargo committed twice
Maritime loop with no meaningful benefit or impossible route

competence.signature_plan: Use shipping only when route benefit exceeds hull, crew, delivery and risk costs
behavioral_rules: Compare legal land versus water route on cost and arrival windows
Reserve ship and cargo exactly once through ordinary transaction APIs
Reject voyage whose visible carrying capacity cannot cover required cargo
competence.adaptation_trigger: If two shipments lose money or miss timings, reroute to proven legal route or reduce fleet spend

personality.preferred_goal: Exploit geography with viable fleets and reliable interprovince supply routes.

profiles.name: The Court Strategist
profiles.persona: Officer-centric player who wins through administration, loyalty, tutoring, and diplomacy.
profiles.goal: Multiply the value of a small officer corps through good assignments and relationships.
behaviors: Recruit or retain talented officers early when it is economically feasible.
Choose assignments by Politics/Charisma and total BP opportunity cost rather than stat alone.
Train/tutor where lifetime gains can plausibly recoup time, gold, and BP.
Prefer diplomacy or personnel gains to war when both can achieve strategic objectives.
blind_spots: Overpays for elite personnel or training when the economy needs liquidity.
May postpone urgent recruitment of ordinary soldiers.
profiles.challenge: Are officers, BP, loyalty, training, and diplomacy valuable but not mandatory min-max bottlenecks?
failure_signatures: One high-stat officer can act indefinitely
Training benefits outrun costs or never repay

competence.signature_plan: Sequence officer BP, loyalty and diplomacy as a constrained multi-turn schedule
competence.strategic_blindspot: Sometimes keeps elite officers training instead of acting
behavioral_rules: Compare recruitment, training, reassignment and diplomacy by net lifetime payoff and BP lock
Protect critical upcoming officer commands before allocating optional BP
Reject a diplomatic gain requiring more than observed affordable treasury and loyalty buffer
competence.adaptation_trigger: If negotiated outcome or tutor improvement underperforms two consecutive windows, revise assignments and plan horizon

personality.preferred_goal: Multiply the value of a small officer corps through good assignments and relationships.
personality.bias_description: Sometimes keeps elite officers training instead of acting

profiles.name: The Busy Delegator
profiles.persona: Time-constrained player who relies on sensible defaults and delegated governors.
profiles.goal: Enjoy a functioning campaign with minimal monthly micromanagement.
behaviors: Set a broad reserve-first governor policy, then mostly accept suggested allocations.
Open spring/fall numerical reports and the menu advisor rather than checking all screens monthly.
Issue direct orders primarily for war, urgent shortages, important projects, or major trades.
Leave standing assignments unchanged unless the result clearly deteriorates.
blind_spots: Misses small persistent inefficiencies and late warning signs.
Can misunderstand what delegated governors may or may not decide.
profiles.challenge: Can a low-click player succeed, understand delegation decisions, and retain real strategic control?
failure_signatures: Governor consumes protected stockpiles
Unsolicited monthly popups, repeated busywork, no reason codes

competence.signature_plan: Choose good persistent governor settings; intervene only for meaningful exceptions
competence.strategic_blindspot: Lags subtle structural decline due to sparse inspections
behavioral_rules: Prefer robust default that avoids starvation and unattended frontier collapse
Use the two monthly decisions on highest visible risk or highest durable payoff
Consult spring and fall reports and only audit key metrics on exception
competence.adaptation_trigger: If advisor or governor flags two consecutive warnings, spend next action on permanent policy repair

personality.preferred_goal: Enjoy a functioning campaign with minimal monthly micromanagement.
personality.bias_description: Lags subtle structural decline due to sparse inspections

profiles.name: The Rules Lawyer
profiles.persona: Adversarial power user who probes legal limits, asymmetries, and edge conditions.
profiles.goal: Find repeatable profitable exploits or irreconcilable state changes, not maximize immersion.
behaviors: Attempt recruit-dismiss, trade split-merge, buy-sell round trips, and zero/maximum order quantities.
Save and reload immediately before tax, harvest, conquest, shipment arrival, and advisor reports.
Attempt parallel reservations of the same people, metal, funds, and ship capacity through legal UI commands.
Use one-factor A/B runs and record exact steps; never edit game memory or cheat in normal test mode.
blind_spots: Unrepresentative of ordinary players; exploit discovery is not evidence of general difficulty.
May ignore enjoyable but non-optimal play styles.
profiles.challenge: Can the game reject illegal states and close dominant unintended loops without blocking legitimate play?
failure_signatures: Resource or person duplication
Zero-price trades, repeat fiscal events, inconsistent save/replay

competence.signature_plan: Find a legal-command exploit with matched controls, then attempt reproduction
competence.strategic_blindspot: Not a representative pursuit of enjoyable victory
behavioral_rules: Probe boundary values and quote changes through the same legal UI/preview
Attempt save/reload, duplicate orders and split/merge operations but never use unauthorized tools
Keep exact expected/actual state deltas and distinguish rejected illegal command from an exploit
competence.adaptation_trigger: If a suspected exploit fails twice with matching controls, move to next untested boundary without declaring success

personality.preferred_goal: Find repeatable profitable exploits or irreconcilable state changes, not maximize immersion.
personality.bias_description: Not a representative pursuit of enjoyable victory

provenance: Director Oct 29 request: increase differentiation and make experienced simulated players more competent. Producer-designed synthetic policies; not validated against original-game after-action reports.

competence_contract.separation: personality goals, risk, values and attention are orthogonal to domain expertise and decision competence; skill is not a personality label or resource multiplier
competence_contract.skill_scales: All numeric skill and evaluation parameters are TEST-HARNESS controls, not runtime economy effects or implicit legal permissions.
competence_contract.legal_information_only: Never access private enemy state, future RNG, internal balances unavailable through the UI, nonplayer APIs, unimplemented modules, or arbitrary save mutations.
competence_contract.knowledge: Known mechanic rules learned from visible game help, player reports, and prior observed effects. Domain expertise improves legal model use, never grants omniscience.
competence_contract.planning_horizon: Effective horizon is min(original preferred horizon, available forecast depth); beyond-forecast scenarios remain uncertain. Expert does not know the future.
decision_pipeline: derive observations consistent with persona inspection and attention
build all legal visible candidates via production enumerate/preview API
if no valid action or worth pursuing, skip month
calculate signed estimated action outcomes using implemented public model outputs
estimate consequence cost: food/treasury/BP/labor/upkeep and projected downside
use domain capability to compare legal alternatives
apply personality priority/risk and skill-limited decision noise with deterministic hashed tie and per-action seed
commit once through normal human command gateway; log chosen and runner-up and reason
update only observed post-commit memory; on new evidence revise plan based on adaptation parameter
competence_contract.candidate_score: PROPOSED ONLY. All action benefit signals must be normalized to documented [-1,1] per category/scenario using exposed pre-action previews, with +1 beneficial and -1 harmful; missing signal neutral and marked. Base utility=sum(weight[k]/100 * signal[k]); subtract observed opportunity costs and downside risk (not hidden actual outcome); add visible specialty fit. Rerank finite candidates. Deterministic skill-noise is applied to estimated utility, never to the legality/commit validator.
competence_contract.critical_safety: All skill tiers share the same mandatory legality and hard no-cheat checks. A novice may fail strategically, but cannot spend resources not owned or bypass engine validation.
competence_contract.available_feature_handling: For absent systems log UNAVAILABLE and use an explicit immutable full-weight/no-opportunity mode. Never silently renormalize eight-category weights. Comparative runs must use one versioned availability policy.
competence_contract.difficulty_testing: Evaluate each persona against its own stated goal and relative to SAME-GOAL weakened competence clone across matched fixtures/seeds; expert is expected to make fewer dominated decisions given the same visible information, not win every war.
competence_contract.test_predictions: Ability to evaluate information and recover improves generally from novice through intermediate/advanced/expert within a matched persona; personality tradeoffs and specialties remain distinct.
